note: 기획 21차: 괴담 방(gd.*) · 돌발 괴담(fe.*) 프롬프트. 방마다 고유 재료(자판기=동전·압축기, 전화=옛 벨, 병동=물방울·카트 …), 돌발 괴담 예고 fe.warn은 7개 모두 같은 금빛 차임.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방: 고장 난 자판기 — 동전 + 압축기 웅웅
sounds.text: Two coins clink and rattle down into an old metal vending machine, then its tired compressor kicks on with a low uneven electric hum and a faint warm wheezing breath from the change slot, fading out.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방: 엘리베이터 속삭임 — 어긋난 딩 + 속삭임
sounds.text: A slightly detuned, off-key elevator arrival ding in a small metal cabin, followed by a faint breathy wordless whisper right behind the listener that hangs in the air and fades.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방: 울리는 공중전화 — 옛날 따르릉 ×2
sounds.text: An old public payphone with a mechanical bell ringer rings twice, brrring brrring, echoing in an empty lobby, then silence.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방: 야근 출석부 — 펜 긁힘 + 시계 째깍
sounds.text: A ballpoint pen scratches a quick signature on paper, then a lonely wall clock ticks four slow ticks in a silent night office.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방: 복사기 — 위잉 기동 + 종이 나옴
sounds.text: An office photocopier whirs up by itself with a rising motor hum and a sweeping scan, then a single sheet of paper slides out with a crisp rustle.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방: 끝나지 않는 복도 — 발소리 4번 + 메아리
sounds.text: Four slow soft footsteps on a linoleum hallway floor, each one answered by a long hollow echo that comes a little too late, in an endless empty corridor.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방: 빨간 휴지 파란 휴지 — 아이 킥킥 + 물방울
sounds.text: A short soft wordless childlike giggle from behind a toilet stall door, then a single water drop plinks onto wet tile in a quiet tiled bathroom.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방: 회진 시간 — 호출 벨 삑 + 카트 바퀴
sounds.text: A hospital nurse-call button beeps once, then small squeaky cart wheels roll slowly closer down a dark ward corridor, rattling faintly, and a second beep.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방: 이름이 적힌 링거 — 물방울 3번 + 긴 잔향
sounds.text: Three slow single drops of liquid fall into an IV drip chamber, each a clear hollow plink with a long cold reverb tail in an empty hospital room.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방: 하늘의 눈 — 깊은 드론 + 깜빡 철퍽
sounds.text: A deep low swelling drone fills a red sky, then one huge wet eyelid blinks with a soft fleshy flap, and the drone sinks away.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방: 빨간 마스크 — 먹먹한 웃음 + 발소리
sounds.text: A muffled wordless giggle heard through a cloth face mask, wavering and slightly off, followed by three slow footsteps on a concrete rooftop.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방: 저주받은 유물 — 사슬 + 부적 + 똑똑
sounds.text: A small iron chain rattles across an old wooden box, paper talismans flutter and rustle, then two knocks come from inside the box.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방 열림 — 전기 지직 ×3 + 웅웅 + 부풂
sounds.text: A fluorescent light tube flickers with three sharp electric zaps, then a low trembling electrical hum and a slow eerie air swell, as if the room itself breathes in.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방 선택지 누름 (안전)
sounds.text: A crisp small button click with a soft low muted thump under it, dry UI tap.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방 선택지 누름 (도박) — 클릭 + 주사위
sounds.text: A crisp button click followed by a few small dice rattling quickly in a cup, short and dry.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방 선택지 누름 (대가·영구) — 클릭 + 낮은 징
sounds.text: A crisp button click, then a low dark gong strike that rings with an ominous metallic shimmer and fades.

sounds.ko: 괴담 결과 직전 깜빡임 — 지직 3번 후 무음
sounds.text: Three quick crackling electric zaps of a dying light bulb, then sudden dead silence.

sounds.ko: 괴담 결과: 좋음 — 따뜻한 부풂 + 장조 + 한숨
sounds.text: Short relieved game result sting: a warm soft airy swell blooms into a gentle bright major chord of soft bell tones, then a quiet relieved exhale of air. Cute mobile game sound, clean and dry, no drums, no speech, no vocals.

sounds.ko: 괴담 결과: 나쁨 — 짧은 불협 찌름 (작게)
sounds.text: Short soft dissonant sting: two slightly clashing buzzy synth tones a half step apart, a brief uneasy stab that fades quickly, not loud. Mobile game sound with a slightly eerie Korean ghost-story mood, clean and dry, no speech, no vocals.

sounds.ko: 괴담 결과: 무난 — 낮은 종 + 바람
sounds.text: A single low temple bell tolls softly while a gentle breeze rises and passes by, calm and a little lonely. Loud, close-up and clearly audible, the sound starts immediately at full volume with no silence before it.

sounds.ko: 괴담 결과: 지나간다 — 멀어지는 발소리
sounds.text: Four soft footsteps walking away down a hallway, each one quieter and farther than the last.

sounds.ko: 흔적 생김: 저주
sounds.text: A low ominous hollow tone with a dark dissonant undertone hums and lingers, like a curse settling on someone, faint ghostly air around it.

sounds.ko: 흔적 생김: 축복
sounds.text: Three soft rising glassy chime twinkles with a gentle warm sparkle, a small blessing gently settling.

sounds.ko: 흔적 생김: 저주+축복 (둘 다 작게)
sounds.text: A quiet low hollow hum under two small bright chime twinkles, short and soft.

sounds.ko: 흔적 사라짐 — 풀리는 거꾸로 차임
sounds.text: A short reversed chime that swells in and cuts off, like a spell unravelling and lifting away.

sounds.ko: 괴담 방 계속 — 문 쿵 + 걸쇠
sounds.text: A heavy old door thuds shut, followed by a small metal latch clicking into place.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 시작: 금두꺼비 — 개굴 ×2 + 동전
sounds.text: A small cute toad croaks twice, ribbit ribbit, then a bright jingle of a few gold coins spilling.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 실패: 금두꺼비 — 낮아지는 개굴 (비웃음)
sounds.text: A cute toad gives three quick croaks dropping lower in pitch each time, like a smug little mocking laugh as it escapes.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 시작: 멈추지 않는 프린터 — 기동음 + 종이
sounds.text: An office laser printer jolts awake by itself with a rising grinding motor whir, then starts spitting paper with fast crisp rustling feeds.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 실패: 프린터
sounds.text: A laser printer motor grinds to a jammed halt with a crunch of crumpled paper, under a sad two-note falling tone, high then low. Cute mobile game failure sound, slightly eerie, clean and dry, no speech, no vocals.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 시작: 잠든 환자 — 느린 삑 + 숨소리
sounds.text: A heart monitor beeps once slowly, then a long deep sleeping breath rises and falls, calm but weak.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 실패: 잠든 환자
sounds.text: Two slow heart monitor beeps sag down in pitch and a tired breath sighs out, under a sad two-note falling tone, high then low. Cute mobile game failure sound, slightly eerie, clean and dry, no speech, no vocals.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 시작: 열린 엘리베이터 통로 — 케이블 삐걱 + 상승 기류
sounds.text: Steel elevator cables creak and groan in a deep open shaft while a rushing updraft of hollow wind swells upward from below.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 실패: 엘리베이터 통로
sounds.text: A hollow updraft in an elevator shaft dies down with one distant cable clunk, under a sad two-note falling tone, high then low. Cute mobile game failure sound, slightly eerie, clean and dry, no speech, no vocals.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 시작: 23:59 정각 — 시계 종 3번 + 째깍
sounds.text: An old wall clock strikes three slow resonant chimes, then fast ticking starts, tick tick tick tick, over an uneasy hollow room tone.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 실패: 23:59 정각
sounds.text: A wall clock's ticking slows down and stops with one dull low bong, under a sad two-note falling tone, high then low. Cute mobile game failure sound, slightly eerie, clean and dry, no speech, no vocals.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 시작: 꺼지는 비상등 — 꺼져 가는 웅웅
sounds.text: The electrical hum of an emergency light buzzes and stutters, sagging down in pitch as the power dies, flickering out into silence.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 실패: 비상등
sounds.text: A light bulb pops and fizzles out with a small electric crackle, under a sad two-note falling tone, high then low. Cute mobile game failure sound, slightly eerie, clean and dry, no speech, no vocals.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 시작: 깨우면 안 되는 아이 — 오르골 자장가 4음
sounds.text: A tiny wind-up music box plays four slow falling lullaby notes, each note ringing clearly and sustained for half a second with a soft warm tail, sleepy and a little eerie, clearly audible and full, not faint. Mobile game sound effect, clean and dry, no other instruments, no speech, no vocals.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 실패: 깨우면 안 되는 아이
sounds.text: A tiny music box winds down, slows and stops on a sour note, under a sad two-note falling tone, high then low. Cute mobile game failure sound, slightly eerie, clean and dry, no speech, no vocals.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 예고 (금빛 표시, 7개 공통)
sounds.text: A quick shimmering golden chime trill of four rising sparkly notes over one low soft bell toll, an attention-grabbing magical alert.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 진행: 비상등 하나 켜짐
sounds.text: A light switch clicks and a lamp flickers on with a small clear bell ping. One single loud, sharp, clearly audible sound right at the very beginning, then silence.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 진행: 적이 승강로로 떨어짐
sounds.text: A cartoon falling whistle sliding down in pitch, then a distant muffled thud far below at the bottom of a deep shaft.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 진행: 그림자 1마리 잡음
sounds.text: A tiny soft poof of a shadow puffing away into smoke, followed by a bright little tick. One single loud, sharp, clearly audible sound right at the very beginning, then silence.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 진행: 아이가 놀람 (짧고 작게)
sounds.text: A tiny short soft wordless whimper of a startled sleeping child, faint and wobbly, not loud.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 진행: 환자 회복 (심전도 삑)
sounds.text: A single short clean heart monitor beep.

sounds.ko: 금두꺼비 점프
sounds.text: A springy cartoon boing as a small toad hops up, wobbly and rising.

sounds.ko: 프린터가 졸개를 뽑아냄 — 종이 철썩
sounds.text: A sheet of paper shoots out of a printer and slaps flat onto the floor, crisp and quick.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 남은 5초 이하 (초마다)
sounds.text: Two quick bright golden ticks, tik-tik, sharp and tiny like a small metal timer.

sounds.ko: 돌발 괴담 성공 — 동전 8개 + 밝은 장화음
sounds.text: Short success sting: a rapid cascade of about eight gold coins jingling, then a bright cheerful major chord of chiptune square tones. Cute punchy mobile game reward sound, clean and dry, no drums, no speech, no vocals.
